display.purpose: Great Vibes. The couple's names in the hero and the RSVP success sign-off — the page's single script moment.

headline.purpose: Noto Serif Display. Story, day, travel, gallery, and RSVP section titles, schedule names, countdown numerals.

body.purpose: Montserrat. Readable explanatory copy for guests, capped around 62ch.

label.purpose: Montserrat 500 uppercase with 0.22em tracking. Navigation, form labels, status tags, countdown labels.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Default paper lift for prominent cards, the nav island, and the mobile menu.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Softer ambient lift for large resting surfaces.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover/emphasis lift for buttons and interactive cards.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing (--ease/--ease-out) for navigation, hovers, menu slide, and reveals.

motion.name: rise-reveal
motion.purpose: Soft entrance for page sections; content stays visible under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: vine-draw
motion.purpose: The scroll-drawn vine on the page's left edge; flowers bloom as their chapters pass.

components.name: Primary RSVP Button
components.description: Pill-shaped ceremonial action button for RSVP submission and other primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: #80A3C2; color: #2E3220; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 12px 11px 34px; font-family: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -16px rgba(67,98,126,0.5); transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #43627E; color: #EFF6FA; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #43627E; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Travel Card
components.description: Compact guest logistics card for travel, stays, and public transport details.
components.html:
Nearby Stays

Recommended hotels and B&Bs close to the venue.

Coming soon
components.css: .ds-travel-card { background: #EFF6FA; color: #2E3220; border: 1px solid rgba(128,163,194,0.35); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; font-family: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-travel-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 26px 60px -28px rgba(72,60,28,0.34); } .ds-travel-card h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-family: 'Noto Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-travel-card p { margin: 0; max-width: 50ch; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-travel-card span { display: inline-block; margin-top: 14px; color: #43627E; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: RSVP Field
components.description: Form field on the pastel-mist RSVP panel: translucent-white fill, hairline ink border, dark ink text.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: #2E3220; font-family: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { color: #45703A; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(46,50,32,0.16); border-radius: 10px; padding: 13px 16px; color: #2E3220; font: inherit; font-size: 0.98rem; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: rgba(46,50,32,0.5); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #43627E; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #43627E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Schedule Row
components.description: Readable day-of-event row with time as the scanning anchor.
components.html:
~1:30 PM
Ceremony

We say our vows at Southdowns Manor. Please be seated a little beforehand.
components.css: .ds-schedule-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 130px 1fr; gap: 24px; padding: 28px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51,54,31,0.14); color: #2E3220; font-family: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-schedule-row time { color: #45703A; font-family: 'Noto Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.3rem; } .ds-schedule-row strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Noto Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-schedule-row p { margin: 0; max-width: 50ch; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.6; } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-schedule-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; } }

narrative.overview: A personal invitation carried through a countryside garden: soft enough for a wedding, clear enough for guests who need practical details, and specific enough to belong to Diego and Bethany. Pale sky-blue paper grounds, spring-foliage greens, a deeper spring-sky blue for accents, and three type families: Great Vibes for the names, Noto Serif Display for headings, Montserrat for everything practical.
keyCharacteristics: Warm practical pages for invited guests
Botanical detail used as a signature, not filler
Soft contrast between sky-blue surfaces and garden-toned accents
Ambient depth and light motion rather than heavy decoration
Clear form, schedule, and travel information above pure ornament

rules.name: Guest-First Contrast
rules.body: Body text stays close to Garden Ink or Invitation Sky; decorative pale text is not allowed to carry essential information.

rules.name: One-Script-Moment
rules.body: Great Vibes appears only on the couple's names in the hero and the RSVP success sign-off; never scatter the script into section titles or accents.

rules.name: Accent-with-Restraint
rules.body: The spring-sky blue marks action, romance, and botanical detail; fresh greens carry structure, the blue carries emphasis.

rules.name: Invitation-Not-Broadsheet
rules.body: Lead with guest clarity; do not turn sections into editorial magazine styling.

rules.name: Soft-Lift
rules.body: Shadows appear only when a surface needs tactile emphasis or hierarchy.

dos: Do preserve the existing color tokens in styles.css.
Do keep guest logistics easy to scan.
Do use Great Vibes only for the couple's names (and the RSVP sign-off that echoes it).
Do use Noto Serif Display for headings and Montserrat for all practical copy and forms.
Do support reduced motion and keep reveal content visible.
donts: Don't make the interface gray, flat, or static.
Don't use generic wedding-template styling that could belong to any couple.
Don't let placeholders dominate the page once real imagery is available.
Don't use side-stripe accent borders, gradient text, or glassmorphism as default scaffolding.
Don't reduce essential guest information to low-contrast decorative color.
